case.summary: GraphSentinel identified card not present fraud involving 3 transaction(s) and $166.97 exposure. The conclusion combines account baseline, episode structure, prior-case memory, and customer denial when present. Actions are policy-routed and do not rely on the model score as a verdict.

sar.narrative: Customer C13171, using card C13171-K2, was associated with suspicious transactions 3557979, 3557987, 3558054 between 2016-12-19 and 2016-12-19. The transactions were for $55.60, $55.69, $55.68, totaling $166.97. They occurred through the online channel and were identified as card not present fraud activity. The cardholder denied the flagged purchase where customer confirmation was available. No reliable shared-device link was needed to reach the decision. Graph traversal and prior-case retrieval showed that the activity was not adequately explained by the risk score alone. The institution opened an internal case and preserved the supporting transaction and relationship evidence. Protective action and monitoring were recommended under the supplied fraud policy.

stop_reason: Customer denial and corroborating graph evidence settle the verdict; the relevant episode and connected entities have been bounded.
